Gideon Sato, here's a draft from #inc-vtg-hartford (times as shown in the channel; it doesn't state a timezone):

Subject: Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026

Mateo,

Summary of the Hartford gate check-in incident:
- First report: Mon Aug 3, 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at the Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailers manually in the meantime.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Check-in of trailer 8836 worked and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

Scheduling stayed available from the dispatch office throughout. Carrowmere Cloud (our hosting vendor) investigated the Hartford gateway route. We're keeping the incident open for another arrival cycle. The separate issue with your login on the status page is still open under ticket INC-4821.

Gideon

Notes: I left out the root cause because the channel doesn't give one. I haven't sent anything. Mateo's address is outside pemberline.com, so emailing it, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval. Tell me if you want me to ask her.
